content:
Maria (Docs): quick heads-up — planning a short deprecation "roadshow" next week to walk through v1->v2 API changes, model swap impacts, and SDK breaking notes. :spiral_calendar:
Sam (DevEx): love it. what's the target audience? PLG users, platform teams, or both?
Maria (Docs): both. half-hour live demo + Q&A for PLG users, and a separate 45m for platform/enterprise with model-swap/rollback playbook.
Eli (Product): can we highlight the automatic fallback rules (region/model tier) and the recommended alias map in the slides? ops teams will ask.
Tara (Content): i'll prepare a one-pager FAQ and a short changelog entry. can someone drop the concise migration snippet i should include?
Jen (SDK): putting a minimal v2 snippet here — please use this in the quickstart and deprecations doc: 
```python
# v1 (legacy)
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-legacy", input="Hello")

# v2 (recommended)
resp = client.responses.create(model="redwood-2.0", input="Hello", modalities=["text"])
```
Noah (Eng): need to call out the behavior change: streaming tokens now use `responses.stream` and the delta event shape changed. a tiny code sample for that too?
Jen (SDK): good call: 
```js
// v1 streaming
client.streamGenerate({ model: 'redwood-legacy' })
.on('data', (d) => console.log(d))

// v2 streaming
for await (const event of client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-2.0' })) {
  if (event.type === 'delta') console.log(event.delta);
}
```
Sam (DevEx): I'll open PRs to replace the old snippets in docs + samples repo. assigning myself to the doc PR but need owners for sample apps.
Maria (Docs): @Sam (DevEx) please include redirects from /docs/api/v1/* to the new migration guide anchors. Tara — can you add a short note about expected timeline & cutoff?
Tara (Content): yes, drafting cutoff language now. prefer "soft sunset" messaging with 60-day notice and compatibility shims called out.
Eli (Product): add a bullet about model aliasing — customers can pin to exact model versions during rollout; link to the alias map guide.
Noah (Eng): quick note on infra: when we flip default model in hosted, we need a controlled rollout flag. I can add the flag and a monitoring dashboard.
Maria (Docs): PR owners: Sam -> docs/snippets PR #2748 (will include Python/JS/Go replacements), Jen -> SDK readme changes PR #2751, Tara -> FAQ PR #2752. please add smoke tests in PR descriptions.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch docs/migration-roadshow (checks: lint, snippets-smoke, linkcheck).
Sam (DevEx): ETA for PRs today EOD. can someone provide a short smoke-test prompt set (2-3 prompts) to validate generation and embeddings?
Jen (SDK): dropping two quick prompts: 
- "Summarize the benefits of using model aliasing for staged rollout."
- "Return a JSON object with title and bullets for migration steps."
These cover json output and plain text.
Tara (Content): noted. i'll include those prompts in the FAQ and add expected outputs to the smoke-test checklist.
Eli (Product): also add a test for fallback: request a heavy latency region model and confirm service falls back per policy.
Noah (Eng): I'll wire up an automated smoke job that runs against the staging routing policy and fails the PR if fallback doesn't trigger.
Maria (Docs): awesome — last ask: collectors for customer questions during the roadshow. i'll make a shared doc; drop any tough Qs you anticipate in the doc so we can craft canned answers.
Sam (DevEx): adding potential Qs now (billing impact of batching, SDK migration steps, embed dim changes).
Jen (SDK): expect a few "my code breaks" posts — we'll publish a compat shim snippet for the most common callsites.
Maria (Docs): perfect. tagging owners in the shared doc. meeting invite will go out in 1hr. :thumbsup:
